source.author: verg
source.text: Una omnes fecere pedem pariterque sinistros, nunc dextros solvere sinus; una ardua torquent cornua detorquentque; ferunt sua flamina classem.
source.text_original: Una omnes fecere pedem pariterque sinistros, / nunc dextros solvere sinus; una ardua torquent / cornua detorquentque; ferunt sua flamina classem.
source.text_english: All together they made one movement with their feet, and at once let out their left and then their right sails; together they twist the lofty yards and untwist them; their own winds drive the fleet onward.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Bistonas ad meritos cum cornua saeva Thyoneus torsit et infelix iam mille furoribus Haemus, iam Rhodopes nemora alta gemunt, talem incita longis porticibus coniunxque fugit natique Lycurgum.
reuse.text_original: Bistonas ad meritos cum cornua saeva Thyoneus / torsit et infelix iam mille furoribus Haemus, / iam Rhodopes nemora alta gemunt, talem incita longis / porticibus coniunxque fugit natique Lycurgum.
reuse.text_english: When Thyoneus had turned his savage horns against the Bistones as they deserved, and cursed Haemus now groaned beneath a thousand frenzies, and now the lofty woods of Rhodope groaned, his wife and sons fled from such a Lycurgus, driven on through the long colonnades.
